title: (2nd LD) Seoul stocks slide over 3 pct on profit-taking amid persistent AI woes
caption:
South Korean semiconductor heavyweights faced a sharp sell-off as market doubts grew over the timeline for artificial intelligence profits. Major chip producers dragged the benchmark index down during Thursday trading.
